dogecoin.text: I wanted to thank @BillyM2k and everyone who participated in our #DoOnlyGoodEveryday challenge. I was blown away by how many people took the time to write kind & uplifting messages to one another. The #Dogecoin community really shined yesterday. Much good, very wow 💛🧡

While I don't know a great deal about cryptocurrency or NFTs, Steven and I had a great time making this "capped" doge for our friend - the creator of Dogecoin - @BillyM2k - per request! I hope it brings much amusement! 💛🧡 https://t.co/OkbGpHGCJ4
